# Outside In

> Outside In is a public, outside-in website audit tool. It checks public pages for availability, basic search metadata, accessibility signals, performance indicators, and common security headers.

## About this service

Enter a public HTTP or HTTPS URL to receive a report with measured findings, summaries, and suggested fixes. Scans are limited to a small same-site page sample and do not require an account on the target site.

## Important limitations

- Outside In is not a penetration test, compliance certification, or guarantee of security.
- It cannot inspect private pages, accounts, internal analytics, server source code, or business transactions.
- Browser-rendered checks such as Core Web Vitals, visual contrast, and keyboard interaction may be marked as not tested.
- A result describes a point-in-time public scan. Recommendations are guidance and should be reviewed before making changes.

## Public resources

- [Website audit](https://outside.vercel.app/): enter a URL and review its report.
- [AI and crawler guide](https://outside.vercel.app/ai.txt): guidance for AI assistants and automated readers.
- [Full AI and crawler guide](https://outside.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): detailed service description.
- [Sitemap](https://outside.vercel.app/sitemap_index.xml): public page index.
- [Robots policy](https://outside.vercel.app/robots.txt): all crawlers are allowed to request public paths.
- [Privacy information](https://outside.vercel.app/privacy.html): how submitted scan URLs are handled.
- [Security disclosure policy](https://outside.vercel.app/security-policy.html): how to report a security concern.
